title: Critical Angle Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the critical angle theta_0 must be correctly derived as a function of omega.

title: Reflection Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of the reflection coefficient R must be accurately presented.

title: Use of Polarization
description: Important Criteria: The response should correctly address the polarization of the X-rays and its implications for the reflection calculation.

title: Mathematical Derivations
description: Important Criteria: Key steps in the derivation of equations must be shown clearly and logically.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should check for consistent use of units throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the equations or final answers should be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any missing factors in the reflection coefficient formula must be identified and corrected.
